## Greater Ooze Demon (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
CE Large outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +22  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 11, flat-footed 23 (+12 natural, –1 size, +2 profane)  
**hp** 190 (10d10+90)  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +3, **Will** +8  
**DR** 10/good; **Immune** acid, electricity, ooze traits; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 22  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** slam +16 (1d6+10 plus 1d4 acid plus grab) or bite +17 (1d6+7 plus 1d4 acid), 2 claws +16 (1d4+7 plus 1d4 acid)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** acid, vomit acid (40-ft. line, 4d6 acid, Ref DC 23 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th)  

1/day—summon (level 7, 2d4 lesser ooze demons or 1 greater ooze demon 35%)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 10, **Con** 26, **Int** 12, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +18 (+22 grapple); **CMD** 28  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
**Skills** Climb +20, Escape Artist +13, Intimidate +15, Knowledge (planes) +14, Perception +22, Stealth +9, Survival +14; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common; telepathy 100 ft.  


**Special Abilities**


**Acid (Ex)** The acidic body of a greater ooze demon quickly dissolves organic material and metal, but not stone. Any melee hit deals acid damage. Armor or clothing dissolves and becomes useless immediately unless it makes a successful DC 23 Reflex save. A metal or wooden weapon that strikes a greater ooze demon dissolves immediately unless it makes a successful DC 23 Reflex save. The save DCs are Constitution-based.
